classification: Both failures were incorrect test expectations; no numerical or caller implementation was changed to satisfy them.

failures.incorrect_expectation: A pointer check's normal flag should be false when existence is false.
failures.source_backed_contract: The compare itself completes normally with exists=false; its branch then makes row.normal=false and skips the store. Keep the already executed encoder prefix.
failures.correction: Assert check.normal=true and check.reference={exists:false}, and retain row.normal=false plus encode-called and store-skipped assertions.

failures.incorrect_expectation: A normally read unknown type value prevents a separately qualified normal direct store and all future calls.
failures.source_backed_contract: A direct Int32 field store does not branch on its numerical value. With read.normal=true and type_store_normally=true, retain a spType write prefix with value=null, then honor independent later read/update qualifications. Actual type effects remain unknown.
failures.correction: Rename the same case to test_replace_unknown_type_value_keeps_qualified_direct_write, assert the cost prefix and unknown-valued type prefix, normal direct store and independent update parameters; actual cost/SP/cycle stay null.
